dedupe_keys.name: national road network rede rodoviaria nacional portugal

description: This geographic dataset contains the Portuguese National Road Network (Rede Rodoviária Nacional), covering the roads managed directly and indirectly by Infraestruturas de Portugal and the rest of the concessioned network. It is published by Infraestruturas de Portugal on the national open data portal. Coverage is national (Portugal). The data are free under CC BY and can be downloaded as a zipped shapefile in the PT-TM06/ETRS89 coordinate system; the dataset is updated quarterly and was last modified in April 2026. Caveats: the portal description is short, so attribute content must be checked in the file, and only the national network is covered. The network supports national road network models, exposure of roads to wildfire, flood and other hazards, and resilience studies. It complements the Spanish OTLE statistics and the European road inventories catalogued here.
